title: Photile.co
description:
Web app that generates a photo grid (tile, mosaic) from your own Instagram photos.

Select the number of rows and columns and filter out unwanted photos.
why: Mostly an excuse to learn Go and try serverless on a real project. I also wanted a grid of my own Instagram photos and nothing simple existed. And it was a small attempt at a paid indie product.
learned: Platform risk. Instagram retired its legacy API and Photile died with it, so I don't build a product on someone else's API without a plan B anymore. On the technical side, I learned Go's concurrency and image handling for compositing photos plus using microservice architecture.
